sites.name: Ganh Da Dia (Ghenh Da Dia)
sites.event: A special national relic, famous for its prismatic basalt columns stacked together like a giant beehive (top 5 most beautiful stone plate cliffs in the world).

sites.name: Mui Dien (Mui Dai Lanh)
sites.event: Home to a lighthouse built by the French in 1890, one of the first places to welcome the dawn on mainland Vietnam.

sites.name: Nhan Tower
sites.event: An ancient Champa tower built around the 12th century, a symbol of Tuy Hoa City, dedicated to the worship of Thien Y A Na.

sites.name: Vung Ro Bay
sites.event: A historical relic of the Ho Chi Minh Trail at Sea, where 'numberless ships' carrying weapon reinforcements for the Southern battlefield were received.

sites.name: Mang Lang Church
sites.event: One of the oldest churches in Vietnam, home to the first book printed in the national Romanized script (Quoc ngu) by Priest Alexandre de Rhodes ('Phep giang tam ngay').

sites.name: O Loan Lagoon
sites.event: A national scenic spot, famous for the renowned O Loan blood cockle specialty.

place.commune: An Cu Commune (and An Hoa Hai, An Hiep, An Ninh Dong Communes)

sites.name: Bai Xep
sites.event: The filming location of the famous movie 'Toi thay hoa vang tren co xanh' with a cactus field and pristine coastline.

sites.name: Da Bia Mountain (Thach Bi Son)
sites.event: Associated with the legend of King Le Thanh Tong carving characters into the stone to mark the border of Dai Viet in 1471 (Da Bia).

sites.name: Van Hoa Plateau
sites.event: Dubbed the 'Da Lat of Phu Yen' with a cool climate, red fruit gardens (dau da dat), and historical resistance relics.

place.commune: Son Long Commune, Son Dinh Commune, Son Xuan Commune

sites.name: Ganh Den (Ganh Den Lighthouse)
sites.event: Featuring an ancient lighthouse and stacked red rocks, located near Ganh Da Dia.

sites.name: Da Trang Pagoda (Bach Thach Tu)
sites.event: A sacred ancient pagoda built in 1797, associated with the 'Da Trang mango' specialty once used as a royal tribute.

sites.name: Ong Cop Bridge (Binh Thanh Bridge)
sites.event: The longest wooden bridge in Vietnam (about 800m), a rustic and unique check-in spot.
